_note: 허브 6장 다음으로 검은 화면이던 타이틀·결과·던전. 전투는 카메라가 보여야 해서 배경을 안 깐다. 스타일은 기존 bg_party를 재사용. keep_bg=true — 크로마키하면 장면이 잘린다. 16:9.

rulesets.bg: Hand-drawn pixel art in the same world as the reference images: same limited earthy palette, thin dark outlines on shapes, soft cel shading, no smooth photographic gradients, not 3D-rendered. A WIDE 16:9 SCENE viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. IMPORTANT: this is a BACKGROUND that dark UI text and buttons will be drawn on top of — keep the left half and the center calm and relatively dark, put the detail and brightness toward the upper right and the edges. Overall value should be MUTED and DARK so light text stays readable. No characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no UI, no frames, no borders.

assets.name: bg_title
assets.prompt: A ruined hillside at late dusk looking toward a distant dark tower under a sky of ash-grey stars. Broken stone steps and a dead tree on the far right, dim ember-orange glow on the horizon. Quiet, mournful, the first screen of a game about death that stays. Left and center stay dark and simple.

assets.name: bg_result
assets.prompt: A dim camp just after battle: a low dying campfire on the right, stacked shields and a torn banner, ash drifting, packed dirt and a few crates. Aftermath, not glory. Warm light only at the edges so a results list can sit in the dark left-center.

assets.name: bg_dungeon
assets.prompt: A branching stone dungeon hall seen from above-front: dark flagstone floor, two archways on the right leading deeper, faint torchlight, moss on cracked pillars. A node-map background, not a maze. Center and left stay dark and uncluttered so a graph of rooms can be drawn on top.
